newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore shares end weaker, outlook remains poor.
newsitem.headline: Singapore shares end weaker, outlook remains poor.

text.p: Singapore shares ended weaker on Tuesday, deflated by short sellers and a poor regional outlook offeringd no hope of an immediate upturn, dealers said.
"The region is in a deflating mood and the shorters are making a comeback," said one dealer with a local firm.

A drop on Tokyo's Nikkei index of 80 points and the shedding of 619 points on Hong Kong's Hang Seng ensured a pessimistic mood stayed in Singapore, adding to currency concerns and fears of the possible merger of certain blue chip share tranches.
Weaker sentiment saw the Straits Times Industrials Index shrug off an early 15-point gain to end at 1,918.53, off 0.32.
